skill.name: elevenlabs-music
skill.description: Create original music from text prompts with the inference.sh CLI for ElevenLabs music generation. Supports duration control and prompt guidance for genres, moods, instruments, and workflows.

skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: The static Ruby backtick findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and inline CLI examples. The real issues are limited to broad infsh CLI permission scope, a remote image request, and mutable external installation guidance. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden command execution was found.

remediation.suggestion: Restrict allowed tools to the specific infsh app run commands required for ElevenLabs music generation.
Host the image through the marketplace asset pipeline or bundle it with the skill documentation.
Pin installation links to a reviewed release tag or include concise setup instructions in the skill file.

content.value_statement: Creators need original music without a full composition workflow. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code prepare ElevenLabs music prompts through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Generates music from text prompts using infsh app run elevenlabs/music.
Provides examples for background music, cinematic scores, genres, short clips, and game audio.
Documents prompt terms for genre, mood, instruments, tempo, and style.
Shows a workflow that combines generated music with ElevenLabs TTS and media merging.
limitations: Requires the infsh CLI and an authenticated inference.sh account.
Relies on external inference.sh and ElevenLabs services.
Does not include local audio editing, mixing, or mastering logic.
Generated results depend on prompt quality and service availability.

use_cases.title: Create Video Background Music
use_cases.description: Generate calm beds, cinematic cues, and transition music for product videos or presentations.

use_cases.title: Produce Podcast Intros
use_cases.description: Create short jingles, outro music, and segment breaks with clear duration targets.

use_cases.title: Prototype Game Audio
use_cases.description: Draft menu themes, exploration loops, and battle music before commissioning final assets.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Background Track
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single usable music bed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the elevenlabs-music skill to generate a 60-second calm background track for a product walkthrough. Include a concise prompt and the command to run.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Genre-Specific Cue
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with instruments and style direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 90-second smooth jazz cue with saxophone lead, walking bass, and brushed drums. Keep the result ready for infsh.

prompt_templates.title: Build Short-Form Audio Variations
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced comparison workflow for social content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three 15-second social media music prompts with different moods. Choose the strongest option and explain why it fits the brief.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Music With Voiceover
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow using music, speech, and merging.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a narration-friendly 60-second music bed, a matching voiceover step, and a final media merge plan using the documented workflow.

output_examples.input: Need music for a product tour video.
output_examples.output: A soft ambient 60-second prompt with duration guidance and a clear next step to generate the track.

output_examples.input: Need a podcast intro that feels professional and modern.
output_examples.output: A 10-second jingle prompt with tech-themed instrumentation, pacing notes, and a review step after generation.

output_examples.input: Need three game music ideas for a fantasy exploration scene.
output: A harp and flute exploration theme with a magical mood.
A soft orchestral loop for quiet discovery moments.
A more rhythmic travel cue for movement across the map.

best_practices: Specify genre, mood, instruments, tempo, and duration in one prompt.
Start with short generations before spending time on long tracks.
Use simple music beds when adding narration or voiceover.
anti_patterns: Do not request a vague track without genre, mood, or use context.
Do not generate long tracks before testing a shorter version.
Do not assume generated music is final without listening and review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code generate music prompts for the inference.sh ElevenLabs music app.

faq.question: Does it create music locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the infsh CLI and external inference.sh services.

faq.question: How long can tracks be?
faq.answer: The documented duration range is 5 to 600 seconds.

faq.question: Can it make podcast intros?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include short podcast jingles, outros, and segment music.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The quick start shows infsh login before generation.

faq.question: Can it combine music with voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents a workflow using ElevenLabs TTS and a media merger app.
